milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the coal_block at ~8,~0,~8 and face it, modeling 'player can see the target.' The coal_block is ~11 blocks from spawn, requiring intentional navigation. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a torch results in the torch item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with no torch, so any torch in inventory confirms successful crafting. The recipe is 1 coal (from mining adjacent coal_ore) + 1 stick (given at start) → 4 torches, so min_count=1 is appropriate.
